theme_central: A psychological and political exposé of the hypocrites: their real disease is craving the riches of this world, masked by deceptive eloquence.

branches.title: False declaration of faith
branches.resume: The hypocrites declare belief but lie; impressive appearance, empty hearts.

children.t: False declared faith, deceptive appearance of the hypocrites

branches.title: Refusal of forgiveness, threat against the Prophet
branches.resume: Refusing to ask forgiveness, threatening to expel the Prophet, reminder that all power belongs to Allah.

children.t: Refusal of forgiveness, threat to expel the Prophet (Abdullah ibn Ubayy)

branches.title: Final warning
branches.resume: Wealth and children must not distract from Allah's remembrance; spend before death arrives.

children.t: Not being distracted by wealth and children, spending before death
